body.message:
Thank you for your response.
​Please note that our team attended to and resolved all reported maintenance issues promptly during your stay.
​Regarding the table, while the original replacement value assessed by our team is AED 2,500, we have reduced the charge to AED 1,000 as a gesture of goodwill to cover replacing the table and disposing of the damaged item.
​The remaining balance of your security deposit will be processed and refunded accordingly.
​Best regards,
